author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I am proposing we leave the hand-off into the gateway exactly as it runs today. The current setup is stable, and touching it risks breaking the live pipeline during a critical promotion week. If we move the shadow chain to run separately, I am willing to accept that the hand-off stays manual for now. This way, we protect the core infrastructure while we verify the new model. I am not asking for a full rebuild of the gateway integration. I am asking for the shadow environment to be isolated so we can test without risking the main deployment. The trade is clear: we keep the existing manual steps for the gateway, but we get a safe space to validate the new forecasting logic before it touches the live system.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts keeping the gateway hand-off manual to gain a safe, isolated environment for testing, stating they are willing to accept this loss to protect the live pipeline.
